state.seed_assertion: The index must be wrapped to zero in the same rung after the ADD and before the next sample to ensure it remains within array bounds during writes.

sentences.1: The index must be wrapped to zero in the same rung after the ADD and before the next sample to ensure it remains within array bounds during writes.
sentences.2: The GEQ and MOV at the end of rung 0 wrap the index to 0 in the same rung, after the ADD and before the next sample, so the index is always inside the array when the writes happen.
sentences.3: An FFL/FFU pair with an FFU on every sample once the FIFO is full does make a ring, at the cost of a copy of the whole array every 10 ms, and the indexed MOV with a wrapping DINT does the same job for one ADD.
sentences.4: An FFL/FFU pair creates a ring buffer at the cost of copying the entire array every 10 ms, whereas an indexed MOV with a wrapping DINT accomplishes the same with one ADD.
sentences.5: The next step beyond a spreadsheet log is transitioning the same fields to mandatory fields in work orders within a CMMS system.
sentences.6: It means know that the same fields in this template, as mandatory fields on a work order instead of optional spreadsheet columns, is the next step once the spreadsheet starts fighting you back.
sentences.7: A periodic task writing to a ring buffer can be used to capture intermittent PLC faults, requiring approximately four rungs and 7 KB of memory.
sentences.8: Detailed log entries enable pattern recognition when the same asset fails again, whereas vague entries require starting analysis from zero.
sentences.9: Digital drives with built-in oscilloscope tools and triggering capability can capture key data prior to the next fault occurrence for analysis.
sentences.10: If one technician writes "PM," another writes "preventive," and a third writes "routine check," your spreadsheet treats them like different events unless someone cleans it up later.
sentences.11: Troubleshooting documentation should be updated immediately during the process to ensure accuracy of electrical drawings, I/O schedules, and network diagrams.
sentences.12: A usable equipment maintenance log must include nine specific fields: asset name/ID, date, maintenance type, description of work, technician, parts used, downtime, and next due date.
